_comment: Guided-flow tables the app loads at startup; edit this file directly (tests/test_routines_json.py checks it).

steps.display: JawOpen: Open your mouth wide

ApeShape: Drop your jaw,
keep your lips together
JawForward: Push your jaw forward, lips together

JawLeft: Slide your jaw to the left,
lips together

JawRight: Slide your jaw to the right,
lips together

MouthLeft: Shift your lips to the left
(jaw still)

MouthRight: Shift your lips to the right
(jaw still)
MouthFunnel: Funnel your lips into an open 'O'

MouthPucker: Pucker your lips (kiss),
lips together

LipRoll: Roll both lips inward
over your teeth
MouthPress: Press your lips firmly together
MouthSmile: Smile with your lips closed
MouthSmileTeeth: Smile and show your teeth
MouthSmileLeft: Smile, left side only
MouthSmileRight: Smile, right side only
MouthFrown: Pull both mouth corners down (frown)
MouthDimple: Pull your mouth corners back tight, tightning the lip corners
MouthStretch: Stretch your lips wide (grimace)

MouthUpperUp: Raise your upper lip,
show upper teeth

MouthUpperUpLeft: Raise your LEFT upper lip only
(Elvis sneer)

MouthUpperUpRight: Raise your RIGHT upper lip only
(Elvis sneer)

MouthLowerDown: Pull your lower lip down,
show lower teeth

MouthShrug: Push your chin up,
pout your lips
NoseSneer: Wrinkle your nose / sneer
CheekPuff: Puff out both cheeks
CheekPuffLeft: Puff out your left cheek only
CheekPuffRight: Puff out your right cheek only
CheekSuck: Suck both cheeks in (fish face)
Stick out your tongue
Tongue out, point it up
Tongue out, point it down
Tongue out, point it left
Tongue out, point it right

Tongue out, roll the sides up
(do your best)

Tongue out, wide and flat
(do your best)

Tongue out, narrow/squished
(do your best)

Tongue out, twist it left
(do your best)

Tongue out, twist it right
(do your best)

Smile WIDE and hold
your jaw OPEN together

Pucker (kiss) with your
jaw dropped open

Frown corners down
with your jaw open
Smile and stick your tongue out

freeform_prompts: Make the silliest face you can!
Big yawn... then a huge grin!
Puff your cheeks side to side!
Raise one brow, then the other!
Stick out your tongue and wave it!
Pretend to chew a giant toffee!
mouth.freeform_intro:
Last step: free play!
Move your face every way you can think
of. Go wild — nothing is too silly!

around until you hear the completion tone.

Alternate: eyes closed, then relax,
in time with the head
Squint your eyes
steps.hold_label:
Squint — now shift the headset
around on your face!

steps.display:
Alternate: squint, then relax,
in time with the head
Open your eyes wide
steps.hold_label:
Eyes wide — now shift the headset
around on your face!

Alternate: eyes wide, then relax,
in time with the head
Angry face: pull your brows down

steps.hold_label:
Brows down — now shift the headset
around on your face!

Alternate: brows down, then relax,
in time with the head

freeform_prompts: Blink as fast as you can!
Slowly close, then pop them open!
Raise one brow at a time!
eye.freeform_intro:
Last step: free play!
Move your eyes and brows every way you
can think of — blink, squint, wink, stare!

onboarding.name: welcome
onboarding.label:
Welcome, and thanks for contributing!
Aim a laser at a button and pull
the trigger to press it.

onboarding.name: routine
onboarding.label:
Which routine would you like to record?
Eyes: blinks, squints and brows.
Mouth: jaw, lips, cheeks and tongue.

onboarding.name: refresh_rate
onboarding.label:
For the best data, set this app's
refresh rate to 144 Hz in SteamVR's
settings before you start.

onboarding.name: purpose
onboarding.label:
You will be shown a series of facial
expressions. Copy each one with your
own face and hold it for a few seconds.

onboarding.name: freeform_intro
onboarding.label:
After the guided part comes free play:
{freeform_seconds} seconds to make every face
you can think of. The sillier, the better!

onboarding.name: consent
onboarding.label:
While this app is open, your headset's
face and eye cameras are recorded to
build a face-tracking dataset. Continue?

onboarding.name: demo
onboarding.label:
The head in front of you demonstrates
each expression, like this one.
Try copying it with your own face!

onboarding.name: practice
